I didn't have character designs, so I made some assumptions and wrote them into the prompt. Replace them with your real designs if you have them, or upload character sheets as reference images.

- **Մտմտիկ (the Thinker):** a calm, thoughtful girl, about 6, with big round glasses and a pencil behind her ear.
- **Պրպտիկ (the Explorer):** an energetic boy, about 6, with a magnifying glass and a backpack full of gadgets.
- **Style:** warm, painterly 3D children's-animation look with a bright, friendly palette. Armenian touches are subtle: an apricot tree and Ararat-style mountains in the far background.
- **Title:** Nano Banana Pro can render text, but Armenian script is less reliable than Latin. I've given two prompts, one with the title and one without. If the letters come out wrong, use the text-free version and set the title in your layout tool.

## FINAL

**Settings:** Model: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) · Aspect ratio: **4:5** · Resolution: **2K** for drafts, **4K** for the final · Generate 4 variations · Optional: attach character reference sheets and add "Keep the characters exactly as in the reference images."

**Prompt A (with title):**

```
A vertical 4:5 poster key visual for a children's animated series for ages 4–8, titled «Մտմտիկ և Պրպտիկ», about two curious kids who ask "why?" about everything.

CHARACTERS (both about 6 years old, friendly, expressive, appealing proportions with large heads and big sparkling eyes):
- Մտմտիկ, "the Thinker": a girl with curly dark-brown hair in two puffs, big round yellow glasses, a pencil tucked behind her ear, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a teal dress. She stands slightly left with a finger tapping her chin, looking up at a floating question mark with a delighted, wondering smile.
- Պրպտիկ, "the Explorer": a boy with messy chestnut hair and freckles, a red cap worn backwards, an orange explorer vest with many pockets, and a small backpack with gadgets poking out. He stands slightly right and leans forward on tiptoe, holding up a big brass magnifying glass that magnifies his eye comically. He looks excited, mid-discovery.

SCENE: The two kids stand on a small grassy hill in the lower-middle of the frame, under a blooming apricot tree. Big, soft, chunky "?" shapes float all around them in the sky like balloons and bubbles, in candy colours (coral, teal, sunshine yellow, lavender). Curious little things fill the scene, each one a "why?": a ladybug, a paper airplane, a rainbow, a tiny planet with a ring, a snail, a lightbulb-shaped cloud. In the far background, soft rolling hills and a gentle snow-capped twin-peaked mountain under a bright morning sky.

COMPOSITION: Strong, readable silhouettes. The characters fill the middle and lower 60% of the frame, facing slightly toward each other and toward the viewer. Leave clean, calm sky in the top 25% for the title. Clear focal point and balanced, cheerful, inviting layout.

TITLE TEXT: At the top centre, the title «Մտմտիկ և Պրպտիկ» in Armenian script, spelled exactly: Մ-տ-մ-տ-ի-կ  և  Պ-ր-պ-տ-ի-կ. Use chunky, rounded, playful hand-lettered type in warm white with a thick coral-orange outline and a soft drop shadow, perfectly legible, every Armenian letter correct. No other text anywhere in the image.

STYLE: High-quality 3D animated feature style with a soft painterly finish, warm golden-morning light, gentle rim light on the characters, soft shadows, rich but not oversaturated colours, subtle textures (knit cardigan, felt cap, grass). Wholesome, safe, joyful, and full of wonder, appealing to young children and parents.

AVOID: scary or sharp elements, dark tones, clutter behind the title, extra characters, misspelled or Latin text, watermarks, logos.
```

**Prompt B (text-free, for adding the title in layout):**

Use Prompt A with two changes:
1. Replace the whole **TITLE TEXT** paragraph with: `Leave the top 25% as clean, soft, gently gradient sky with a few small floating question marks at the edges, as empty space reserved for a title added later. Absolutely no text, letters, or typography anywhere in the image.`
2. In the **AVOID** line, replace `misspelled or Latin text` with `any text or letters`.

**Fix-up edit prompt** (if the title letters come out wrong on an otherwise good image, send it back with this):
```
Keep everything in the image exactly the same, but correct the title text at the top so it reads exactly «Մտմտիկ և Պրպտիկ» in Armenian (Մ-տ-մ-տ-ի-կ և Պ-ր-պ-տ-ի-կ), in the same chunky rounded white lettering with a coral-orange outline.
```
